data.narrative:
Monarch Quantum is a Growth-stage quantum computing company founded by Dr. Timothy Day (Stanford-trained physicist and prior founder of Daylight Solutions) alongside CTO Michael Pushkarsky and operating executives Bryan Taylor and Eric Takeuchi. The company has raised $115M+ in capital and contracts. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comparables and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method, applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of the Growth-to-next-stage transition to the $115M total raised proxy, yielding $138M. Peer-median triangulation is not supportable; while 8 quantum computing peers exist, none satisfy narrow filtering criteria for same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tier, falling short of the minimum three-datapoint threshold. Applying an all-sector median would introduce undue noise given the heterogeneity of quantum computing business models and maturity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $117M to $159M, with a median of $138M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries meaningful uncertainty stemming from the sparse comparable set in quantum computing at the Growth stage. Key uncertainties include the sustainability of technical roadmap execution, regulatory pathway clarity for quantum applications, and near-term revenue visibility—standard for frontier hardware at this stage.
